notice: Separate financial-assumption register. Every figure is an unverified modelled projection, planning target or illustrative valuation estimate. No figure is reported performance, investor evidence, a verified market observation or an offer. Metadata checks prove internal consistency only.

confidenceScale.Low: Management estimate or design target with no attached primary source, measurement or reviewer sign-off.
confidenceScale.Medium: At least one named, dated primary or authoritative secondary source attached, with method notes and owner confirmation.
confidenceScale.High: Independent sources or completed measurement, with method, date, evidence reference and reviewer sign-off.

users.definition: Registered accounts in the stated horizon; not monthly active buyers and not reported traction.

gmv.definition: Gross merchandise value before refunds, taxes, duties, fulfilment, payment cost and revenue share. Modelled as Users × Buyer conversion × Orders per buyer × AOV.

netRevenue.definition: Recognised platform revenue after seller payouts and agreed revenue share; not GMV and not cash collected.

takeRate.definition: Net revenue divided by GMV for the same horizon, including transactional and non-GMV revenue components where stated.

cac.definition: Blended customer acquisition cost: total acquisition spend divided by newly acquired registered users in the modelled period.

aov.definition: Average order value: modelled GMV divided by modelled orders in the same horizon.

repeatPurchaseRate.definition: Share of registered users with a qualifying repeat purchase within the defined twelve-month measurement window.

contributionMargin.definition: Net revenue less variable fulfilment, payment, leakage and directly attributable acquisition cost, divided by net revenue.

enterpriseValue.definition: Illustrative multiple-based valuation range using Y8 revenue multiples; no cap table, audited accounts, market evidence or transaction is attached.
